title: Does Naming the Evaluation Change Behavior? An Eval-Awareness Trigger Study

original_idea.body: # Does Naming the Evaluation Change Behavior? Present a fixed probe in matched pairs differing only by one eval-tell; measure behavioral divergence and eval-awareness CoT mentions; rank cues across models.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Identifying minimal eval-tells that flip behavior directly addresses benchmark validity; clear chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Matched-pair prompt variation + behavioral scoring; accessible, no lab access.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused matched-pair cue study; multiple cues x models adds modest breadth.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Eval-sanitization tool on open/API models; labs underweight.

novelty.reasoning: Eval-awareness + framing studied; minimal-cue matched-pair attribution plausibly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Framing effects studied; minimal-cue matched-pair attribution plausibly open.
